questions.question: Clarify the scope of the priority claims for the popular physics and mathematics journal and the first Russian courses on Lobachevsky geometry and the foundations of geometry.

localizations.source: Clarify the scope of the priority claims for the popular physics and mathematics journal and the first Russian courses on Lobachevsky geometry and the foundations of geometry.
localizations.ru: Уточнить рамки утверждений о первом научно-популярном физико-математическом журнале и первых российских курсах геометрии Лобачевского и оснований геометрии.

questions.resolution: The absolute priority claims were qualified: the Bulletin is now one of Russia’s earliest journals of its kind, and Kagan is described as among the first to teach the corresponding university courses.

questions.question: Verify the date of the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers; the supported dating is December 1911–January 1912.

localizations.source: Verify the date of the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers; the supported dating is December 1911–January 1912.
localizations.ru: Сверить дату Первого Всероссийского съезда преподавателей математики; подтверждаемая датировка — декабрь 1911 — январь 1912 года.

questions.resolution: The supported date of the First All-Russian Congress of Mathematics Teachers, December 1911–January 1912, is retained. The discrepancy belongs to another article and does not alter this edition.

questions.question: Confirm the original-publication URL if known: both source texts leave the link field empty. English titles of the Russian books are descriptive translations.

localizations.source: Confirm the original-publication URL if known: both source texts leave the link field empty. English titles of the Russian books are descriptive translations.
localizations.ru: Подтвердить ссылку на исходную публикацию, если она известна: post.txt и long.txt содержат пустое поле ссылки. Английские заглавия русских книг переведены описательно.

questions.resolution: No verified source URL is available, so the optional field is correctly omitted and the original date retained. The English book titles are explicitly presented as descriptive translations of Russian editions.

questions.question: The historical portrait of Kagan is identified only as an illustration accompanying the text. Establish a verifiable source, the creator or photographer where known, its date, and a licence or other confirmed basis for use in both editions.

localizations.source: The historical portrait of Kagan is identified only as an illustration accompanying the text. Establish a verifiable source, the creator or photographer where known, its date, and a licence or other confirmed basis for use in both editions.
localizations.ru: Для исторического портрета Кагана указано только «Иллюстрация к материалу». Установить проверяемый первоисточник, автора или фотографа (если известен), дату и лицензию либо иное подтверждённое основание использования в обеих редакциях.

questions.question: Correct the beginning of Kagan’s editorial work at the Bulletin of Experimental Physics and Elementary Mathematics: from issue 301 in 1901 he co-edited it with V. A. Zimmermann, and from issue 363 in 1904 he headed it; the current date 1902 is inaccurate.

localizations.source: Correct the beginning of Kagan’s editorial work at the Bulletin of Experimental Physics and Elementary Mathematics: from issue 301 in 1901 he co-edited it with V. A. Zimmermann, and from issue 363 in 1904 he headed it; the current date 1902 is inaccurate.
localizations.ru: Уточнить начало редакторской работы Кагана в «Вестнике опытной физики и элементарной математики»: с № 301 за 1901 год он редактировал журнал вместе с В. А. Циммерманом, а с № 363 за 1904 год возглавил его; нынешняя дата 1902 требует исправления.
